verification_instructions: 1. Run `pnpm run test -- --watch=false` in ui/ to verify tests pass. 2. Run `pnpm exec ng build` in ui/ to verify production build compiles. 3. Run `make ui-i18n-extract` from project root to regenerate XLF source. 4. Verify i18n entries exist in messages.ja.xlf.
snapshot_or_generated_files: ui/src/locale/messages.xlf is regenerated by `make ui-i18n-extract`. messages.ja.xlf must be manually updated with translations for new entries.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access. No PostgreSQL needed for this UI-only change.
contribution_requirements: Branch naming: feature/display-user-role. All user-facing text must use Angular i18n with @@customId syntax. Source locale English, translations in Japanese (messages.ja.xlf). After adding text, run `make ui-i18n-extract` and update Japanese translations. Use `pnpm exec` not `npx`. Use `$localize` for TypeScript strings.
key_patterns: Sidebar component already shows user email and logout when authMode !== 'none'. Auth service exposes currentUser signal with role field. Backend /auth/me already returns role. TailwindCSS v4 for styling. Standalone Angular components.
directory_structure: ui/src/app/layout/ contains header and sidebar components. ui/src/app/services/ contains auth.service.ts with User interface (id, email, name, role). ui/src/locale/ contains translation files.
